data.name: Carbonera
data.description: Carbonera (carbonera.vc) describes itself as an investor set up to back innovators that remove greenhouse gases such as CO2 from the atmosphere. Its site lists offices in Burgos, Spain and Hong Kong. Other businesses use the same name, including the US carbon-offset marketplace Carbonera eXchange and a biochar and activated-carbon startup on VC4A, so the seed entry's identity should be confirmed.
